execution_policy: One primary review task and at most one bivariate task, serially under existing locks. Remaining budget is reserve, not permission for automatic expansion.

priorities.title: Bind the changed log near-one path to rigorous error evidence
priorities.reason: New cr_log_tiny code passes finite tests but approximation/model binding is not yet closed.
priorities.next_action: Review exact cr_log_tiny coefficients, operation ordering and stopping allowance against logtiny.g; independently certify the approximation or state a precise remaining premise.
priorities.deliverable: Pinned source-to-model binding and rigorous bounded certificate replay, with unresolved premises explicit.
priorities.acceptance: Passing corpora and dirtyinfnorm are not proofs; separate approximation, operation error and rounding-test allowance.
priorities.stop: Checkpoint at missing dependency, changed source or cap; never promote an exploratory norm to a certificate.
priorities.dependency: Pinned log.c/logtiny.g/logtiny.sollya and qualified proof tools; no paused exp work.
priorities.change: Full current Clang corpus passes four modes; changed source/model inventoried and proof binding remains open.

priorities.title: Close sine build and cosine proof follow-through
priorities.reason: A newly changed sine preprocessor directive blocks compilation; prior cosine proof obligations remain distinct.
priorities.next_action: Check adoption of the tested sine preprocessor patch and the prior cosine sign correction; preserve full census/fallback obligations without repeating unchanged tests.
priorities.deliverable: Minimal tested sine build patch and pinned cosine adoption/completeness checkpoint.
priorities.acceptance: No whole-function proof or unreachability claim from corpus tests; keep supplied-data verification separate from exhaustive regeneration.
priorities.stop: Checkpoint on changed source or missing premise; do not repeat unchanged campaigns.
priorities.dependency: Pinned cosine source/proof and subsequent maintainer feedback; no broad coverage or exp campaign.
priorities.change: Current sine fails GCC/Clang compilation; one-character correction restores both builds. Cosine proof/input identities unchanged, sign candidate still open.

priorities.title: Build independently checkable bivariate regression evidence, hypot first
priorities.reason: The unary suite does not cover the much larger two-input space; small exact certificates can separate generating difficult cases from verifying them.
priorities.next_action: Check adoption of the eight certified midpoint-plus-one pairs; next construct a complementary below-midpoint or near-representable family in a bounded unit, not a larger unchanged sweep.
priorities.deliverable: A standalone exact checker, explicit certificate format and separately qualified four-mode runner; later a hashed archive-import/reproduction receipt.
priorities.acceptance: Exact input decoding, positive/negative controls and bounds; values, flags and errno separate. Table verification does not regenerate a completeness census. No new bug or novelty claim from a hard-but-correct case.
priorities.stop: Stop on a failed control or cap. Recheck archive availability at the next checkpoint, report the blocker once and continue independent infrastructure work; do not silently drop the requested import.
priorities.dependency: Independent verifier and Linux adapter qualified for listed GCC/Clang profiles only. Prior archives are still unavailable; their results remain unverified here.
priorities.change: Eight exact unordered pairs plus swaps certified, absent under sign/swap/power2 membership at the full pinned corpus, and pass 128 GCC/Clang four-mode observations with controls. No census or novelty claim.
